implementation_summary: auditContentRoutes({ store, caller }) returns the content and file rows, taking method, path and access from AUDIT_API (both 'view', no beta policy). Content reads Page Content with store.readVersionJson(pageContentName(path)); file reads the screenshot with store.getVersionFile. Access goes through mayUseAudit(view); a Helper without a grant gets 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND, the same as preview. The version defaults to the latest. A bad version or path gives 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST, and an unknown audit, version, page or file gives 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND. The file route requires a relative path with an image extension (png, jpg, jpeg, webp) and refuses a leading '/', '..', a backslash, '%' or control characters; the store re-checks the name before reading. It replies with an image Content-Type, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff and Cache-Control no-store. Store failures go through refuseStoreFailure, which gives a fixed-sentence 500.
risks: The file route serves only image extensions, so preview.html or other version files cannot be fetched through it.
The 500 sentence reuses refuseStoreFailure from audit-store.ts ('The saved audits could not be read or changed. Try again.'), so the wording is not specific to content.
Content for a page that exists in the result but has no stored Page Content answers 404.
handoff: BE-190: register ...auditContentRoutes({ store, caller }) in routes/index.ts, using the same store and caller as auditStoreRoutes and auditPreviewRoutes. Export it from audit-content.ts, which routes/index.ts does not do yet. The wizard calls content with ?path=<urlPath>&version=; the file route's path must be a screenshotPath value as recorded in the result.
